enhancement.description: Classic arcade maze chase with ghosts and power pellets, playable in the browser.
enhancement.prompt: Build me a Pacman game that works as a single HTML page with the classic maze, dots, power pellets, ghosts, and scoring, letting me play with the arrow keys and restart when I lose.
enhancement.response:
I've built your Pacman game. Here's what it does:  
- Control Pacman with arrow keys to navigate the maze  
- Eat all dots to clear the board and advance to the next level  
- Avoid the four ghosts that each have their own chase patterns  
- Eat power pellets to turn ghosts blue, letting you eat them for bonus points  
- Track your current score, high score, and remaining lives  
The game renders on a canvas with classic arcade visuals. Just start playing using the UI controls or keyboard.
